status: finished grounding experiment; narrow value reading only, assistant not qualified
objective: one mixed batch per update: story practice, paired counterfactual grounding, reviewed replay
update_definition: one AdamW step on one batch of exactly 16 whole rows (3 story windows of at most 1,024 bytes, 10 grounding turns, 3 replay turns), right-padded to 1,024 columns, with one forward and one backward pass; 1,000 updates are therefore 1,000 batches
model_family_origin: our own randomly initialized byte/EOD language Transformer

resource_limits.accounting: the wall clock starts when the trainer starts, so loading, baseline validation, in-loop validation and checkpoint writes all count; supervised targets are positions with positive loss weight in all three streams, checked before each update; memory is process peak RSS plus GPU driver allocation and each alone; caps are checked between complete updates

optimizer.reset: fresh AdamW; the parent's saved moments and batch generator state are discarded and never used
optimizer.continuity: one optimizer and one set of generators across all phases; nothing is reset at a phase change

limitations: Validation selects weights and is not qualification. All tool results are synthetic. Caps are checked between complete updates.
